verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way for users to define event-based rules that trigger actions automatically. Leo's continuous monitoring with alerts in Pendo and Slack is vendor-driven alerting, not user-defined trigger-action rules. Automatic flagging of frustration signals is a built-in analytics behavior. Both are adjacent features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
